topPRs.title: Add @quantoracle/plugin-quantoracle
topPRs.author: fel123
topPRs.body:
Adds QuantOracle plugin — 63 deterministic quant finance calculators + 10 composite workflows. - Repo: https://github.com/QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle - API: https://api.quantoracle.dev (1,000 free calls/day; x402 USDC on Base or Solana for paid endpoints) - Actions (11): Black-Scholes option pricing, full risk analysis, strategy backtesting (SMA/RSI/momentum/Bollinger), options strategy optimizer, hedging recommendations, portfolio rebalance planning, portfolio optimization, Monte Carlo simulation, pairs trading signals, impermanent loss, liquidation price. Single-line addition to \`index.json\` (alphabetical position between \`@pyboom\` and \`@standujar\`). ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * The QuantOracle plugin package is now available for installation and use.

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single registry entry for `@quantoracle/plugin-quantoracle`, mapping it to `github:QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle`. The JSON formatting, comma placement, and alphabetical position are all correct. - The target repository `QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle` could not be found via web search — only the separate `QuantOracledev/quantoracle` repo is publicly discoverable. If the plugin repo is missing or private, CLI installs will fail with a 404.

Confidence Score: 3/5

Not safe to merge until the referenced GitHub repository is confirmed to be public and accessible. The sole substantive concern is a P1: the registry points to `QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle`, which cannot be verified to exist as a public repo. If it is absent or private, every CLI install attempt will fail. The JSON change itself is correctly formatted and placed, so this is a single, addressable blocker. index.json — specifically the repository reference on the new line.

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `@quantoracle/plugin-quantoracle` → `github:QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle`; JSON format, comma placement, and alphabetical position are all correct, but the target repository could not be verified to exist publicly. |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant User participant CLI as ElizaOS CLI participant Registry as elizaos-plugins/registry participant GitHub as github.com/QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle User->>CLI: eliza add @quantoracle/plugin-quantoracle CLI->>Registry: fetch index.json Registry-->>CLI: "github:QuantOracledev/plugin-quantoracle" CLI->>GitHub: resolve & download repository GitHub-->>CLI: plugin source (or 404 if repo absent) CLI-->>User: plugin installed (or error) ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["Add @quantoracle/plugin-quantoracle"](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/commit/e5d5171c35a71bb26e9c5124ffde96105e4c9049) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=28879551) > Greptile also left **1 inline comment** on this PR.
